question: With what kinds of names beginning with Praṇava and ending in heart forms is the rite performed?
premises: Names beginning with Praṇava are used.
They end in fourth and heart forms.
They are used together with Īśa-related elements.
inference: The rite uses names beginning with Praṇava, ending in fourth and heart forms, together with Īśa names.
uncertainties: Exact grammatical forms of caturthīhṛdanta are interpreted from context.
plain_english: With names beginning with Om, ending in the fourth and heart forms, together with Īśa names.
